speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: Master Shakespeare? Cuthbert Burbage. From Holywell, before my father is up.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You have me. Say it while the house is still a house.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: He went on Wednesday to look at a hall in the Blackfriars. Stone. Roofed. The old friars' dining-room. Dry as a bone, and out of the Lord Mayor's reach. He came home walking like a man of thirty.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Wednesday. And he has a figure, or he has a walk.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: He'll not tell me what's asked. He holds up six fingers and I pray it's shillings. No one is to speak of it. There is nothing to speak of.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I have not heard a price. I will not invent one to be helpful.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: You have a friend in that precinct. The printer. What manner of neighbours are they? I am asking as a man who may have to live beside the answer.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Respectable. They like quiet, and a sermon, and to be abed by nine.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: Then we'd be as welcome as a drum in Lent.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: You didn't need to. God keep you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And you. Tell him the king's at two, and to wear both cloaks.
